name: Southeastern Cable Contractors, Inc.
old_description: Throughout her career, Helena has led and supported major multi-million-dollar telecom projects for service providers, engineering firms, construction teams, and government partners. She specializes in project management, RDOF and BEAD initiatives, permitting strategy, operational optimization, and cross-functional leadership, helping organizations strengthen partnerships, improve efficiency, and successfully bring complex infrastructure projects from concept to completion.
about:
Southeastern Cable Contractors, Inc. is based in Southport, North Carolina. The company has nearly two decades of experience in broadband infrastructure construction, though a specific founding year is not publicly stated. It describes itself as a veteran-led operation serving cable multiple-system operators (MSOs) and network providers across the Southeast.

The firm provides complete, turnkey telecom and utility construction services. Its capabilities span aerial cable construction, underground cable construction, micro-trenching, fiber and coaxial installation, and government-subsidy projects such as BEAD and RDOF. It also handles MDU and ISP installations, permitting and engineering, project management, and warehouse/inventory logistics. The company reports millions of feet of broadband subsidy construction completed and over 5,000 miles of fiber construction for government-funded initiatives. It operates with a 70% in-house W-2 crew model and can establish new market branches in 30–60 days, backed by millions of dollars invested in equipment.

Southeastern Cable serves cable MSOs, network providers, and government-funded broadband programs. Its customer base includes residential drops, large-scale commercial projects, government-funded infrastructure, multi-dwelling units, and enterprise clients. The company emphasizes work across the Southeast region.

The company says it differentiates itself through single-point accountability, a 99.4%+ post-inspection score, OSHA-compliant safety practices with weekly training, and a philosophy of enabling MSOs to focus on their business rather than managing contractors. It positions itself as a one-stop telecommunications construction partner combining skilled crews, equipment, and reliable execution.

name: Southern Maple Co
old_description: Mark has been studying and practicing the art of furniture making for 8 years. His work can be seen from CA to NY, as well as in businesses including the Omni Hotel and Able in Nashville, where he’s lived since 2009.
about:
Southern Maple Co operates from Nashville, Tennessee, where it was founded in 2009. The company began when owner Randy Cuba relocated to Nashville in 2015 and joined the Fort Houston maker space, building on woodworking skills passed down from his father. After refining his craft there, Cuba launched Southern Maple Co as a dedicated custom woodworking shop.

The shop produces custom furniture and cabinetry for both residential and commercial clients. Using traditional handcrafted methods, the team handles design, joinery, finishing, and installation. The workforce includes Cuba and craftsman Mark Shreve, who brings eight years of furniture-making experience; the operation runs from a Nashville workshop without a disclosed facility size or headcount.

Southern Maple serves homeowners, interior designers, and businesses in the hospitality and commercial sectors. Notable projects include pieces for the Omni Hotel and the Nashville venue Able, with work shipped to clients from California to New York.

Cuba emphasizes a collaborative process, keeping clients involved from concept through completion, and aims to create heirloom-quality pieces built to last. The company’s founding was driven by a desire to bring clients’ ideas to life through hands-on craftsmanship.

Client collaboration integrated throughout design and build

name: Southern Medical Corporation
old_description: SMC was founded in 1987 in response to a shortage of trained technologists able to perform competent cardiovascular services. SMC strives to provide a comprehensive range of products and services while maintaining an excellent reputation for quality
about:
Southern Medical Corporation was founded in 1987 in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, in response to a shortage of trained technologists capable of performing competent cardiovascular services. The company began as a provider of specialized cardiovascular technologists and has since expanded its scope.

Today, SMC delivers a range of technical and clinical services including mobile ultrasound operations across Louisiana, Mississippi, and Texas, nuclear medicine services, biomedical resource management, and healthcare consulting. The company operates mobile units and provides on-site technical support, though facility size and headcount are not disclosed.

SMC serves hospitals, clinics, and healthcare facilities requiring cardiovascular, diagnostic imaging, and nuclear medicine support. Its affiliate relationships with American Diagnostic Technologies and Etech Medical Solution extend its service network. The company also offers equipment and supply procurement for medical facilities.

Founded to address a critical staffing gap, SMC emphasizes a comprehensive service portfolio and a reputation for quality and dependability. The firm highlights its multi-state mobile ultrasound capability and its focus on professional growth for its technologists as key differentiators.

name: Southern Metal Fabricators
old_description: Southern Metal Fabricators specializes in custom carbon steel and aluminum fabrication for industrial applications — platforms and handrails, bulk storage tanks and silos, hoppers, ductwork, conveyor structures, and material handling equipment. We build to spec, deliver on time, and have the time-earned experience to consult on your drawings before a single piece of metal is fabricated.
about:
Southern Metal Fabricators operates from Albertville, Alabama, where it was founded in 1991 by Charles Bailey as a two-man shop serving local maintenance and light fabrication needs. The company remains family-owned, with Bailey's sons Ashton and Whitton now active in the business alongside their father, who serves as president and CEO.

The firm provides custom carbon steel, stainless steel, and aluminum fabrication for industrial applications, producing platforms, handrails, bulk storage tanks, silos, hoppers, ductwork, conveyor structures, and material handling equipment. Its 130,000-square-foot high-bay facility sits on six acres of laydown yard and is served by overhead cranes up to 35 tons. In-house capabilities span design (AutoCAD, MTC Shape Cutting, Pro Nest), cutting, forming, welding (AWS D1.1, D1.2, D1.6 certified), finishing (hot-dip galvanizing, priming, painting), assembly, and detailing, with a dedicated quality inspector overseeing every project.

Customers come from agriculture, architecture, automotive, cement, construction, coal and biomass, egg and poultry, feed and grain, iron and steel, mining and quarry, marine, petroleum, paper, plastics, power generation, retail, utilities, and woodworking. The company builds to spec for both industrial and commercial projects, from small transfer carts to large bulk hoppers.

Southern Metal Fabricators differentiates itself by keeping all fabrication under one roof, a philosophy summed up as "Tool up to handle any custom metal fabrication job, start to finish, right here on the premises." It pre-assembles and test-runs products before shipping, assigns a dedicated point of contact for each project, and maintains welding procedures conforming to ASME Section IX and API-650 standards, as well as Canadian Welding Bureau registration.

about:
Southern Motion was founded in 1996 in Pontotoc, Mississippi, by Guy Lipscomb and his wife Sandy. The couple named the company after a painting titled "Southern Motion" they discovered while shopping, which captured the spirit of relaxation and comfort they wanted to build into their furniture. From the start, the goal was singular: manufacture only reclining furniture and make it better than anyone else had.

Today the company operates five facilities in northern Mississippi and employs more than 1,500 workers. Its product line spans sofas, sectionals, recliners, and accent chairs equipped with features such as power headrests, massage and heat systems (branded SoCozi™), wireless charging, wall-hugger mechanisms, and swivel-glider bases. The furniture is marketed as American-made with both domestic and imported components.

Southern Motion sells through a network of independent retailers across the United States, Canada, and Mexico. Its customers are primarily residential consumers seeking motion furniture for living rooms and home theaters. The company does not disclose specific commercial or institutional clients.

Leadership emphasizes that American workers can produce a quality, competitively priced product, and the brand positions itself as a design and innovation leader in the motion-furniture category. Community involvement, including long-term support for the American Cancer Society's Relay for Life and other local charities, is also highlighted as part of the company's identity.

name: Southern Packaging, LP
old_description: Join over 900 satisfied clients and browse our inventory of industrial bulk packaging products to find your perfect solution.
about:
Founded in 2004 in Venus, Texas, Southern Packaging, LP has grown into a major distributor of industrial bulk packaging. The company is privately held; no founders are named in public materials.

The firm supplies a broad line of flexible intermediate bulk containers (FIBCs), liners, multi-wall paper bags, polyethylene and woven polypropylene bags, BOPP bags, UN-certified hazardous-material packaging, container liners, load-protection products, slip sheets, pallet covers, and stretch film. It operates warehouses near Dallas–Fort Worth that stock more than 1,100 SKUs and serves nearly 900 customer locations across the United States. In 2025 the company reported shipping 100 million bags. It also offers vendor-managed inventory programs, custom package design, and bag-filling equipment for powders, flakes, and granules.

Southern Packaging’s customer base consists primarily of manufacturers in sectors such as agriculture (deer corn and wildlife feed), chemicals (hazardous materials), and general dry-flowable product handling. The company emphasizes supply-chain partnership and technical expertise to help clients navigate packaging specifications.

The company differentiates itself with the largest on-demand inventory of FIBCs and multi-wall paper packaging in North America, same-day shipping on stocked items, established relationships with top manufacturers, and a service model built on guaranteed products, responsive support, and reliable on-time delivery.

name: Southpaw Furniture Co
old_description: Solid hardwood furniture expertly handcrafted in our 5,000 sq ft workshop and delivered nationwide – our furniture is built to last a lifetime. If you are looking to make your house feel like a home you are in the right place.
about:
Southpaw Furniture Co operates from Sturtevant, Wisconsin, where a family-owned workshop has grown from a garage startup into a 5,500-square-foot manufacturing facility with a dedicated 400-square-foot spray booth. The company does not disclose a founding year, but its origins trace back to a passion for solid hardwood craftsmanship that now employs multiple full-time woodworkers.

The shop produces custom dining tables, kitchen islands, side tables, and built-in cabinetry, all milled and assembled from prime-grade hardwoods such as walnut and white oak. Each piece moves through hand-cut joinery, sanding, and spray finishing in-house, allowing the team to control color matching and surface quality. The facility’s capacity supports both one-off commissions and repeat orders for residential and commercial clients.

Homeowners make up the core customer base, though the company also furnishes businesses seeking durable, made-to-measure pieces. Reviews highlight projects ranging from oval dining tables with custom stain samples shipped for in-home approval to white-oak kitchen islands with tailored drawer inserts and pull-out mechanisms. The collaborative design process includes physical wood samples and detailed drawings before production begins.

Southpaw’s stated mission centers on sustainability, quality, and personalization—creating furniture intended to last generations rather than seasons. The founders emphasize integrity in client relationships and a commitment to using only solid hardwoods, avoiding veneers or particle board. That philosophy, they say, distinguishes their work from mass-produced alternatives and drives repeat business from clients who value heirloom-grade construction.

name: Sovereign Plastics
old_description: At Sovereign Plastics we know that defining and following structured processes is a key element in consistently delivering high quality parts.  For each of our products, we develop and maintain a Process Quality Document (PQD)...
about:
Sovereign Plastics operates from a 23,000-square-foot facility in Colorado Springs, Colorado. The company was acquired in June 2022 by The Landers Companies, LLC, a Tucson, Arizona-based holding company; no founding year or original founders are disclosed.

The shop specializes in custom injection molding and in-house mold making, producing over 100 molds annually. Its facility separates machining from molding operations and includes capacity for light assembly, fulfillment, and packaging. The company emphasizes short-run molding flexibility alongside high-production-rate capability.

Sovereign serves automotive, medical, consumer, and industrial markets worldwide. Customers range from prototype-stage developers to established OEMs requiring consistent quality across global supply chains.

The company differentiates itself through a proprietary Process Quality Document (PQD) system that captures customer requirements from critical dimensions to cosmetic standards. It guarantees molds for the life of a project as long as it continues molding the parts, using a high-grade alloy and proprietary software for mold design and maintenance.

name: Space Tables Inc
old_description: Space Tables is a family owned company. To us, the table is the heart of every home. Whether that home is a private residence or an assisted living facility, the table is where people come together to share a meal, share their time, and share their lives.
about:
Space Tables Inc. operates from Maple Grove, Minnesota, where it was founded in 1976 as a family‑owned business. The company later became certified as a woman‑owned enterprise. Its origin traces to 1977, when the firm developed one of the first wheelchair‑accessible patio tables after a customer suggested focusing on the healthcare market.

The company manufactures indoor and outdoor dining tables for senior living communities, assisted‑living facilities, restaurants, and private residences. Its product lines include the Orlando, Sanibel, Vegas, and Cheyenne collections, each customizable with a range of finishes. Production capabilities cover steel column fabrication, stamped steel legs, zinc undercoating, and outdoor‑grade powder coating, allowing tables to withstand heavy institutional use.

Primary customers are operators of senior housing, skilled‑nursing centers, and hospitality venues. Testimonials on the company’s site reference nursing‑home residents, caregivers, and restaurant owners who value the tables’ adjustable height and durability. The firm also serves residential buyers seeking accessible furniture.

Space Tables says its mission is to create innovative products that help residents live with independence. The leadership emphasizes listening to customers to improve and invent new solutions, and it highlights the combination of family‑ownership continuity and woman‑owned certification as a differentiator in the contract‑furniture market.

name: Spacestor New York Design Centre
old_description: New York founded recruitment experts, Robert Half International, know how to treat their employees and have worked alongside Arch Design to fit out a workspace informed by human-centric design thinking.
about:
Spacestor operates a New York design centre as part of a global furniture brand that originated in the United Kingdom. The company traces its roots to nearly three decades ago as a UK-based innovator in workspace furniture and design thinking. Ten years ago it expanded to California, opening a design centre to observe evolving workplace cultures, and later established a presence in New York. Ownership structure and founders are not publicly disclosed.

The firm designs and manufactures modular, customizable furniture systems that define architectural space. Product lines include meeting pods and booths (Portals, Railway Carriage, Verandas), zoning systems (Aeonica, Palisades), lockers (HotLocker), system walls (Signature Storagewall, Snugglestor), freestanding storage (Forte), tables and benches (Zee, Rip), seating (Bleachers), and desking (Zee Bench Desk). Production occurs at the company's own factories, supported by a digital customizer tool and 2D/3D design files. Headcount is reported as 2,000 globally.

Spacestor serves a broad range of sectors, with documented projects in financial services (BlackRock, JP Morgan, Allianz, Grant Thornton), professional services (Pinsent Masons, PKF London, Dentsu), technology and IT (Autodesk, Synopsys, Google), government and defense (Stockton Council, Arvest), co-working (Wizu Workspace), real estate (Gleeds, Tristan Capital Partners), sciences (Pfizer), sports media and entertainment, food and drink, education, manufacturing, nonprofit, publishing, retail, travel and aviation, and architecture and design.

The company positions its differentiation on blending "California Cool with London Design" across a global network of design centres. It emphasizes sustainability, a "kit-of-parts" modular approach, and a mission to improve workspaces for happiness, creativity, and teamwork. Spacestor states it donates approximately 10% of profits to local schools and charities.
